scope: Straight South axes with elevated parallel2/3 camera for dining tables, grand pianos and flagged desks; matching anonymous family-table opposite facings share art.
camera: Root-accepted camera benchmarks preserve top and front with useful physical depth, real curves, raised piano lids and rich original materials. New native aspects uniformly contain inside unchanged original views; no old-draw stretching or mathematical perspective warps.
sourceDeduplication: Each of30 family dining products already deliberately shared the exact same original South/North source file+crop. Each corrected pair reuses one exact new file+crop while retaining per-facing original view/foot metadata. Distinct rear drawings elsewhere are untouched.
packing: Native generated RGBA copied/cropped and lossless WebP encoded; no pixel warps, palette edits or alpha remapping. Complete silhouettes include detached benches/stools/pedals. Original generation PNGs retained alongside isolated native sources.
retainedAudit: Inspected189 unique current South sources:93 collection dining/coffee/instrument,62 family tables,31 collection desks,legacy teak desk,and2 earlier flagged legacy pieces. Retained109 already-useful sources including coffee tables, non-grand instrument displays,29 desks,the Rustic standard/family dining source,and corrected furniture-5-180/recital-platform sources.
